name: anaglyph-wasm
description: Browser image/gif/video to anaglyph 3-D converter (wasm + WebGPU + WebCodecs)

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --features gpu --lib && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/anaglyph_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web
